# codencode.my

> Affordable coding, AI and cybersecurity academy based in Johor Bahru, Malaysia. Two offering types: fully online multi-week Core Subjects (Python, Machine Learning, Cybersecurity, Vibe Coding) and half-day in-person AI workshops at Mount Austin, Johor Bahru. Taught in English, Mandarin (中文) and Bahasa Melayu.

codencode.my (legal entity: CODE N CODE SOLUTION, 202603072017 / AS0511861-M) runs live, instructor-led online courses for beginners through career changers. No prior experience required. Every session is recorded and uploaded within 24 hours. First class is free.

## Core Subjects (fully online, multi-week, delivered live via Zoom)
- Python Fundamentals — 6 weeks + 1 week project, beginner, RM 1,500, 100% online.
- Machine Learning Fundamentals — 10 weeks, intermediate, RM 1,800, 100% online.
- Cybersecurity Fundamentals — 6 weeks + 1 week project, beginner, RM 1,500, 100% online. Phishing, password hygiene, network basics, intro pentesting — for anyone who touches a work laptop.
- Vibe Coding (building apps with AI tools: Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude) — 4 weeks, beginner, RM 800, 100% online.

All Core Subjects are taught in English, Mandarin and Bahasa Melayu, delivered online via Zoom.

## AI for ___ Workshops (in-person, half-day, one-off, not enrolled programs)

Workshops are single half-day sessions, distinct from the multi-week Core Subjects — they are fixed-format, in-person events, not enrolled courses.
